title: Paving pathways for inclusion: Towards evidence-based policy-making for refugee education — Country profile: Chad
why_not: States that the yearbook's collection is by paper-based surveys, which is the census only. UNHCR's own SIGE links individual refugee pupils to ProGres records since 2017, but who enters it and in which schools is not stated, and the held 2021 case study already covers it.
